album.title: Almost Us
album.description: Thirteen independent acoustic-romance instrumentals, from finding a home in someone to grounded solitude. Nylon guitar, piano, bowed strings and intimate soul; not chiptune.

songs.title: Finding a Home in You
songs.emotion: Instrumental verse and answering refrain, darker middle, short guitar coda.
songs.caption: The Signal

songs.cover_alt: A lone slate-roofed house with one warmly glowing divided window stands on a rugged mossy island in a moonlit blue lake. Broken gold reflections and low mist lead toward distant mountain ranges.

songs.cover_alt: A sculpted mint-green vintage rotary telephone fills a low three-quarter view. Its dark handset floats just above the cradle, and a coiled cord loops across a reflective counter before rain-streaked amber city lights.

songs.title: She Likes Me Too
songs.emotion: Waltz head, two contrasting piano choruses, brief bass-led break, head out.
songs.caption: The Signal

songs.cover_alt: Two ribbed honey-gold paper lanterns rise diagonally through layers of ivory and apricot blossom branches. Bamboo hoops, paper pleats and delicate tassels catch their internal golden light against deep violet and teal twilight clouds.

songs.title: Until Morning
songs.emotion: Low-register lyrical head, expanding soul refrain, quiet96-108s bridge, warm return.
songs.caption: The Signal
songs.cover_alt: An empty teal leather corner booth embraces a chrome-rimmed cafe table with two different ceramic coffee cups, faint steam and a coffee ring. A brass opal lamp glows beside soaring windows overlooking a lavender-coral dawn.

songs.title: Tell Me Everything
songs.emotion: Cello question, guitar answer, longer arch, exposed duet middle, intertwined return.
songs.caption: The Possibility
songs.cover_alt: An open, handwritten book on a walnut desk sends curved letters and open envelopes into a luminous spiral, threaded with burgundy silk; a wax seal and brass fountain pen rest beside it. No people.

songs.title: This Is Getting Serious
songs.emotion: Tango subject, bowed answer, displaced development, suspended middle and decisive reprise.
songs.caption: The Possibility
songs.bundle_path: Almost Us/06 - This Is Getting Serious

songs.wav_file: AUDIO/Almost Us/06 - This Is Getting Serious.wav
songs.mp3_file: AUDIO/Almost Us/06 - This Is Getting Serious.mp3
songs.cover_alt: Twin curved, weathered stone staircases climb above dense blue-grey cloud, with full risers, arched piers and slender brass railings. Their brass-edged top landings almost meet around a small gap and one amber lantern. No people.

songs.title: I Think I'm Falling
songs.emotion: Immediate chorus hook, verse, lifted refrain,112-118s dry guitar break,136s full return.
songs.caption: The Possibility
songs.bundle_path: Almost Us/07 - I Think I'm Falling
songs.source_file: STRUDEL/Almost Us/07 - I Think I'm Falling/song.strudel
songs.wav_file: AUDIO/Almost Us/07 - I Think I'm Falling.wav
songs.mp3_file: AUDIO/Almost Us/07 - I Think I'm Falling.mp3
songs.cover_alt: A gently tilted grand piano hangs weightlessly above amber clouds: its curved raised lid, exposed brass strings, eighty-eight keys, pierced music desk, three turned legs and pedals are visible. Rose-gold silk and golden petals drift around it. No people.

songs.title: The Questions
songs.emotion: Four30-second piano passes at15/45/75/105, subtract guitar then bass; separate intro/coda.
songs.caption: The Self-Check
songs.cover_alt: Steep aerial view of a monumental weathered blue-stone circular maze in mirror water, with differently broken concentric walls, long diagonal shadows, cold lake fog and one warmly lit closed book.

songs.title: What If
songs.emotion: Insistent low hook, contrasting treble question, sparse bridge, tightening refrain and collapse.
songs.caption: The Self-Check
songs.cover_alt: A low viewpoint over wet silver rails, detailed timber sleepers and dark gravel at a three-way coastal junction. An amber signal stands left; wires, a gantry and distant forked white lightning disappear into layered teal storm mist.

songs.title: The Answer
songs.emotion: Lyrical piano statement, answering development, wider middle, restrained return and153s silence.
songs.caption: The Self-Check
songs.cover_alt: A substantial black origami boat with visible folded-paper facets floats in the lower center of dark silvery tidal water. Gentle water ripples, wet rocks and a jagged distant coast frame an enormous soft silver eclipse in layered charcoal mist.

songs.title: Almost Us
songs.emotion: Bowed theme, lower cello reply, harmonic detour,132-172s chamber climax, intimate cadence.
songs.caption: Almost Us
songs.cover_alt: Two richly weathered stone bridge halves reach toward each other above a violet mist-filled gorge. An unmistakable missing center separates their arched masonry. Wisteria and ivy hang below gold-lit coping stones, with a slender waterfall and layered purple mountains far behind. No people or human forms.

songs.title: Don't Look For Me
songs.emotion: Solo nylon head, low-register answer, harmonic-color middle, stripped restatement, two piano cues.
songs.caption: Almost Us

songs.cover_alt: An ornate tarnished brass key with silver edging sinks diagonally through slate-blue water. Its open filigree bow, fluted shaft, collars, and genuinely notched teeth catch the final pale light. A detached, frayed black silk ribbon drifts upward beside tiny bubbles and slanting underwater light shafts. No people, hands, or human forms.

songs.title: Alone, But Not Empty
songs.emotion: Open piano refrain, varied verse, plagal lift,140-148s solo, grounded return,186s long-release ending.
songs.caption: After

songs.cover_alt: A lush solitary tree spreads thousands of distinct green leaves above a sunlit limestone cliff. Its exposed roots grip cracked rock among dewy ferns, grasses, moss and tiny pale wildflowers. A small bright sun and soft cloud layers rise behind the right canopy, casting amber leaf rims and shafts through cool mint coastal mist.
